definitions.gloss: complete defeat; total loss; utter defeat
definitions.explanation: A thorough, decisive defeat with no redeeming factors. Often used in sports and competitions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{完敗|かんぱい}だった。
examples.english: Today's match was a complete defeat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{完敗|かんぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}した→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧。
examples.english: We suffered a total defeat at the hands of the opposing team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{完敗|かんぱい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The candidate who suffered a crushing defeat in the election announced their retirement.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with ⟦{喫|きっ}する→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧ (to suffer/sustain) in the formal expression {完敗|かんぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}する→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧. Common in sports reporting and political commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {完敗|かんぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}する→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧ (to suffer a complete defeat)
- {完敗|かんぱい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end in total defeat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{惨敗|ざんぱい}→惨敗：08236_zanpai⟧: miserable defeat (emphasizes how devastating it was)
- ⟦{大敗|たいはい}→大敗：08201_taihai⟧: major defeat (large-scale loss)
- ⟦{完勝|かんしょう}→完勝：18824_kanshou⟧: complete victory (the opposite)
